title: Compaction is TTL-aware for the explicit opt-in path
acceptance: Budget-triggered compaction inside the configured contextPruning TTL returns ok=true, compacted=false and the stable cache-TTL deferral reason before checkpoint capture or transcript rewrite.
Cold TTL, opt-in off and non-eligible providers preserve the existing compaction path.
Manual, overflow and timeout recovery are never deferred by the cache-TTL gate.
The new config defaults to false and no frozen default, product lock or provider cache-control policy changes.
The implementation reuses the existing openclaw.cache-ttl marker and contextPruning TTL settings; no keepalive or TTL refresh is introduced.
